player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛgɛ {player_id}. I ye Memory Game ka jɛgɛ.
I ka kan ye ka kɛɛ kɔɔri caman ka tɔɔ kɛɛ kɔɔri lajɛn fɛ, o lajɛn ka kan.
I ka tɔɔ bɛɛ, kɛɛ kɔɔri fila ka tɔɔ kɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma, kɔɔri kelen bɛɛ kɔɔri kelen bɛɛ, fila ma '[0 1 1 0]', kɔɔri kelen bɛɛ kɔɔri kelen bɛɛ lajɛn fila ma.
Ni kɔɔri fila ye ɲɔgɔn, i bɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma, kɔɔri fila bɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma. Ni a lajɛn, kɔɔri fila bɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma, kɔɔri fila bɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma, e.g. '.'.
Jɛgɛ bɛɛ ka kɔɔri fila ye ɲɔgɔn.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jurusirabɔla {player_id} ma jaabili kɛ ni tagamasiɲɛ ɲuman ye.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Jurusarabali.Jurutigi {player_id} ye yɔrɔ dɔ sugandi ka bɔ kɛnɛma.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Jurusarabaga {player_id} ye kariti kelen sugandi siɲɛ fila.
invalid_move.already_matched: Jurusarabali.Jurutigi {player_id} ye kariti kelen wala fila sugandi ka sɔrɔ u bɛɛ bɛnna ɲɔgɔn ma fɔlɔ.

game_message.cards_match: Kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma ye ɲɔgɔn! Jɛgɛ {player_id} ma kɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma ka kan [{r1} {c1}] ni [{r2} {c2}].
game_message.cards_no_match: Kɛɛ kɔnɔ {player_id} ye mina ka kɛɛw bɛɛ tɛ se. Kɛɛw ye [{r1} {c1}] ani [{r2} {c2}] bɛ {pos1} ani {pos2} ye.

outcome.draw: U fila bɛɛ ye kariti kelenw di.
outcome.turn_limit: Tɔɔ kɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma ka kan ye kɔɔri. Jɛgɛ bɛɛ kɔɔri fila lajɛn fila ma. Jɛgɛ 0 ma kɛɛ {score_0} kɔɔri, jɛgɛ 1 ma kɛɛ {score_1} kɔɔri.
